answer: In an agent marketplace, workers such as marble, reef and comet each lock a $100 bond for 30 days before accepting jobs, and each bond permits only one active job. A verifier checks submitted computations against deterministic results; an invalid result forfeits the bond. Creating 1,000 fake workers therefore ties up $100,000, and using them to submit false results risks losing that capital. Extra names never create extra unbacked capacity.
